post.description:
Book dates instantly. The exclusion constraint `no_overlap` is the only guard against
double-booking: there is no check-then-insert, so concurrent requests for the same dates
produce exactly one 201 and 409 for the rest.

409.description: Dates already booked or outside availability

post.description: Cancel before handover. Both holds are refunded and the dates are freed.

get.description: Handover and return evidence side by side, for the damage comparison screen.

post.description:
Lender reports damage after comparing handover and return evidence. The deposit is
split by fixed tier: minor 20%, moderate 40%, severe 70%, total 100% to the lender.

Prototype simplification: the plan has an admin choose the tier; with no admin role
yet, the lender's tier is applied directly.
Record the handover checklist and condition photos, and start the fee hold timer.

get.description: Every simulated money movement for a booking; each event sums to zero.

post.description: Record the return checklist and photos. The lender then settles the deposit.
Lender confirms the item came back fine: the full deposit is refunded.

get.description:
Aggregates for the borrower (savings) and lender (earnings) dashboards.

Savings is an estimate: the listing deposit stands in for the item's replacement
value, so savings = sum(max(deposit - fee, 0)) over non-cancelled rentals.
Search active listings. `from`/`to` keep only listings free for the whole range.
Stations available for the location filter and the listing-form fallback.

post.description:
Suggest day/week/month prices before the listing exists. Falls back to a
median-based heuristic whenever the model is unavailable, slow or invalid.

get.description: Advisory view for the date picker. The booking insert re-checks atomically.

put.description: Replace the listing's open windows. Existing bookings are unaffected.

post.description:
Attach an uploaded photo to one of your listings. Booking evidence is attached
through the handover and return checklists instead.

Issue a short-lived direct-upload URL. PUT the file there with the given headers,
then attach the key to a listing (`POST /media`, or `photo_keys` on listing creation)
or to a handover/return checklist (`media_keys`).

get.description: Reviews received by a user, newest first.

post.description:
Two-sided: the borrower reviews the lender and the lender reviews the borrower,
once each per booking, after the item is returned.
